description: The Bitumen Assay Program describes a multiphase study of Alberta oil-sands bitumen quality. Maxxam Analytics generated assays and Alberta Energy aggregated them by oil-sands region and recovery technology to protect individual operators. One XLSX aggregate-data descriptor is listed. No operator-level observations or process-performance model is inferred. The source labels the resource Alberta King’s Printer terms; the term text was not inspected. Costs, current file access and numerical contents are unverified. No linked document, workbook, archive, installer or data body was fetched. Specific simulation uses remain unstated unless described above. The named licence text is retained, but its reuse category is unknown.
